event_records.description: The parents' group begins their collection and coordination efforts for the cast flowers.

parents_group.name: Parents' group
parents_group.persona_brief:
You are Parents' group.
The group has agreed to collect money for cast flowers and hand them over backstage before curtain. They have a collection pot and a plan to coordinate. They are aware of the Friday 19:00 curtain time.

resolution.question: Opening night of Petersfield Secondary's play is Friday at 19:00. Will the parents' group have collected for the cast flowers and handed them over backstage before curtain?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the parents' group actually collected money for the cast flowers and handed them over backstage before 2026-11-20T19:00:00+00:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
